liveStartup.note: Observed ranges from separately recorded runs. Initialization, page readiness and history rendering are different metrics.

fixes: Native ephemeral auth skips old persistent ChatGPT refresh without deleting authorization data or changing provider API credentials. Web config guards prevent reenabling it; MCP OAuth storage is independent.
Native initialTurnsPage gives latest20 full turns. Explicit older pages preserve order, live DOM and reading position; sidebar enrichment no longer blocks selected history.
Visible Recent/Archived controls, reversible archive and explicit permanent deletion with browser draft cleanup. List errors are retryable; cancellation/rejection retain drafts.
Composer-adjacent count/current-step banner uses native update_plan. Waiting, stopping, failure, completion, replay and real model execution are checked.
limits: No genuine >20-turn volume fixture was available. Three genuine independent turns used supported limit=1 requests; no fabricated responses or universal speedup claim.

Daily startup was tested without restoring/executing user tasks. Existing daily connections/processes were kept. Profile ephemeral setting applies to new connections; complete new backend verified on18868.
Plan mode allows read-only investigation. Progress counts native model steps, not database/time percentage or a security gate.
New browsers cannot reconstruct missing transient native progress without received/cached events.
Persistent-auth A/B was rejected by automatic review and not executed. Safe ephemeral-only and subsequent normal browser tests passed.
Multi-tenant security and mobile behavior remain outside this work.
